title: Winne-comack / Commack
summary: Winne-comack is associated with modern Commack. Shorter Comac and Comack forms are kept as alternate spellings of the same placename rather than separate map sites.
history_content: The history gives a general placename orientation for Commack while citation and dated record details remain still being source-checked.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Winne-comack, Winnecomack, Winniecomac, Comac, Comack, and Commack. The interpretation remains uncertain, so the public wording stays limited to the recorded forms.

Why Place Names Matter

“The names we give to places do more than provide labels for a map. A name represents the meaning which a place holds to a person or group. It helps us remember what a place is, who lives there, and why it is important. It identifies the significance of an area’s history.”

— National Park Service, About the Name (n.d.), opening text, before ‘Bears Lodge or Devils Tower’
